description: Realized price of a UTXO cohort: the satoshi-weighted mean Bitcoin spot price at which its currently unspent outputs were created, calculated as Σ(creation price × unspent sats) / Σ(unspent sats). It is the cohort's aggregate on-chain cost basis. Returns zero when the cohort has no unspent supply. Uses all UTXOs. Reported in USD per BTC.
